lines.text: Wholesale prices jumped 1.3% in a single month.
lines.say: Wholesale prices jumped one point three percent in a single month.

lines.text: That's September's Producer Price Index, the biggest monthly jump since March 2022.
lines.say: That's September's Producer Price Index, the biggest monthly jump since March twenty twenty-two.

lines.text: PPI tracks the prices US producers get for what they sell.
lines.say: P P I tracks the prices US producers get for what they sell.

lines.text: Over 12 months it's up 6.3%, the most since December 2022, when it hit 6.4%.
lines.say: Over twelve months, it's up six point three percent, the most since December twenty twenty-two, when it hit six point four percent.

lines.text: Goods prices alone rose 2.6% in September, with energy doing most of the pushing.
lines.say: Goods prices alone rose two point six percent in September, with energy doing most of the pushing.

lines.text: Why care? When businesses pay more, that cost gets passed to shoppers, eaten in thinner margins, or some of both.
lines.say: Why care? When businesses pay more, that cost gets passed to shoppers, eaten in thinner margins, or some of both.

lines.text: The Fed watches it right next to the consumer price report from October 14.
lines.say: The Fed watches this right next to the consumer price report from October fourteenth.

lines.text: Simple version: PPI is the upstream cost, and CPI is your receipt.
lines.say: Simple version: P P I is the upstream cost, and C P I is your receipt.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: Wholesale prices jumped 1.3% in one month. Here's why
post.ig:
Wholesale prices jumped 1.3% in a single month.
The Producer Price Index rose 1.3% in September 2026, the biggest monthly gain since March 2022 (BLS, Oct 15, 2026).
Over 12 months it's up 6.3%, the most since December 2022.
Goods prices rose 2.6% in September, led by energy.
Source: Bureau of Labor Statistics.
